history.text: Write a highly detailed, descriptive prompt of this image in English for an AI text-to-image generator (such as Midjourney, DALL-E, or Stable Diffusion). Describe the objects, background, style, lighting, color palette, and mood in detail. Do NOT include any introductory or concluding conversational text. Do not say 'Here is the prompt' or similar. Output ONLY the raw description of the image.

A young Asian man with short, dark hair and glasses is captured in a medium shot, leaning against a railing on a staircase at night. He is wearing a plain black t-shirt with a small red logo, possibly a polo player, on the left chest, and black pants. His left arm is resting on the railing, with his hand slightly bent, and his right hand is casually tucked into his pocket. He is looking off to the right, with a neutral expression. The background is dark and somewhat blurred, featuring textured concrete walls, railings, and the silhouettes of palm trees and other foliage. The lighting is dim, creating a moody atmosphere with strong shadows and highlights, emphasizing the textures of the environment and the man's features. The overall color palette is dominated by deep blacks, grays, and muted greens from the plants, with a subtle contrast from the red logo. The style is realistic, with a touch of cinematic or urban photography.
